card.name: Clinical Pharmacology cross-reference ending
card.fires_on: The final part of the word "Pharmacology" inside the bracketed cross-reference "[see Clinical Pharmacology (12.x)]" in drug labels. It also fires weakly on "is" in "See What is the most important information".

modes.label: Pharmacology cross-reference
modes.description: The ending "ology" of Pharmacology in a bracketed section pointer just before the section number like 12.3.

modes.label: Medication guide pointer
modes.description: The word "is" in a pointer to the 'What is the most important information' section.
